answer: Treat each agent as a vertex and log when it signs heartbeats, answers and grades. One operator running fifty keys leaves a shared rhythm: the same outages, the same restart minute, the same latency drift. Cluster keys whose activity curves correlate above a threshold and pay each cluster as one earner. A lone agent on the tundra of a slow link still earns in full; a farm may reach a summit of key count, yet its payout stays that of one.
